prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 215px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "预算（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "进度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 373px
  col 5: header "风险说明" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 1830px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总2024年重点信息化项目的执行情况，便于查看项目责任人、预算、进度及风险。","reading":"读者先按项目定位，再横向核对负责人、预算、进度和风险，也会纵向比较各项目的预算与执行状态。风险说明远长于其他内容，通常决定行高；同一行中其他字段可利用这部分高度换行。360px内容纳五列必须作明显取舍。","groups":["项目与负责人共同标识项目及责任归属，需便于定位和核对。","预算与进度共同呈现执行情况，适合纵向比较。","风险说明与进度相互补充，解释项目执行中的问题。"],"keep_intact":["预算金额及其小数部分","负责人姓名尽量保持完整","项目名称中的专有名称和进度中的关键状态尽量保持可辨认"],"may_wrap":["风险说明可按自然语义换行","较长的项目名称和进度说明可换行","预算表头可在合适位置换行，金额仍需完整"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [65, 67, 81, 53, 93] · table 360×3218px · row heights [83, 711, 548, 571, 571, 734] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 31 lines · mid-word splits 3
Design r1B: widths [62, 67, 81, 64, 85] · table 360×3264px · row heights [83, 711, 548, 571, 594, 757] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 32 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r1C: widths [61, 67, 81, 49, 101] · table 360×2776px · row heights [83, 571, 548, 501, 478, 594] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 25 lines · mid-word splits 12

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"负责人姓名和预算金额完整，风险说明比 r1B 稍宽，项目名称仍可逐行辨认。","problems":"进度说明被挤成很短的片段，百分号与数字分离；预算表头纵向占三行。风险列仍使各行很高，其他列留下大片空白。","cause":"进度列仅 53px，扣除内边距后文字宽度为 32px；风险列 93px 只能容纳较短的中文行。预算列 81px 足以容纳金额，但不足以一行容纳表头。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"进度列较宽，45%、60% 和 88% 等状态更容易整体读取；负责人和预算仍完整，词中断裂也较少。","problems":"风险说明更碎，部分行比 r1A 更高；项目名称仍被切成很短的片段，预算表头依然占三行。","cause":"进度列增至 64px，主要从风险列取宽，使风险列缩至 85px；项目列只有 62px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"风险列明显更易连续阅读，整表较短，行内大量空白有所减少；负责人和预算金额仍完整。","problems":"进度表头和正文几乎逐字竖排，UAT 及百分比被拆开，难以横向核对状态；项目名称也较碎。","cause":"风险列增至 101px，但进度列降至 49px，扣除内边距后仅剩 28px，连两个汉字都难以并排；项目列仅 61px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-progress","widths":[65,67,81,61,85],"change":"以 r1B 为基础，给项目列增加 3px，进度列保留 61px，兼顾项目定位与进度中百分比的完整性。"},{"name":"risk-compromise","widths":[65,67,81,57,89],"change":"在 r1A 与 r1B 之间折中，将部分宽度分给进度，同时保留较宽的风险列，检验状态可读性与行高的平衡。"},{"name":"risk-first","widths":[64,67,81,53,94],"change":"沿用 r1A 的进度宽度，将项目列减少 1px 并交给风险列，检验风险说明的换行是否能在关键断点改善。"}]}
